title: Tel Aviv-based Bay, which helps companies find AI agents and set guardrails, emerges from stealth with a $37M Series A led by Battery Ventures and a $13M seed (Chris Metinko/Axios)
summary: Chris Metinko / Axios: Tel Aviv-based Bay, which helps companies find AI agents and set guardrails, emerges from stealth with a $37M Series A led by Battery Ventures and a $13M seed — Agentic cybersecurity startup Bay emerged from stealth with $50 million raised, CEO Yuval Zacharia tells Axios Pro exclusively.
